spells.name: Deadly Precision
spells.description: Use: Increases your Critical Strike by 52 for 20 sec. Every time one of your non-periodic spells deals a critical strike, the bonus is reduced by 10. (3 Min Cooldown)

spells.name: Void Tendril
spells.description: Equip: Your damaging spells have a chance to summon a void tendril near your target's location, dealing 166 Shadow damage to all enemies within 4 yds after a brief delay.

spells.name: Void Hunter
spells.description: Equip: Increases your Intellect against Aberrations by 2.

spells.name: Whispers of L'ura
spells.description: Use: Listen to the Whispers of L'ura for 45 sec, granting the chance for your healing spells to heal for an additional 419. (3 Min Cooldown)

193708.name: Platinum Star Band
193708.description: Tattukiaka in Iskaara would be interested in this sort of thing.

spells.name: Emerald Coach's Whistle
spells.description: Use: Select a target friendly player to coach. (1 Sec Cooldown)

spells.name: Emerald Coach's Whistle
spells.description: Equip: Your helpful spells and abilities have a chance to pep up you and your Coached ally, granting you both 31 Mastery for 10 sec.

spells.name: Collect Argussian Crate
spells.description: Use: Add this Decor to your House Chest.

spells.name: Thalassian Phoenix Torque
spells.description:
Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to call upon the Phoenix Flames to envelop your target.

If your target is friendly, they are healed for 11,730 over 10 sec. If your target is an enemy, they instead suffer 7,821 Fire damage over 10 sec.

Every unique socketed gem color will strengthen the flames by 1%.

spells.name: Signet of Azerothian Blessings
spells.description:
Equip: Your spells and abilities may cause the signet to resonate with the Worldsoul, granting you a boon of 4 to all of your secondary stats for 15 sec.

Every unique socketed gem color strengthens their associated secondary stat granted by this boon by 1%.

241340.name: Magister's Alchemist Stone
241340.description: Can be used for transmutations in place of a Philosopher's Stone.

spells.name: Magister's Alchemist Stone
spells.description: Equip: When you heal or deal damage you have a chance to increase your Strength, Agility, or Intellect by 162 for 15 sec. Your highest stat is always chosen.

spells.name: Alchemist Stone
spells.description: Equip: Increases the effect that healing and mana potions have on the wearer by 40%.  This effect does not stack.

spells.name: Ranger-General's Call
spells.description: Equip: Dealing damage to a target has a chance to mark them, causing an Elven Ranger to launch a Surprise Attack from afar! This surprise attack deals 6,530 Physical damage to the target.

spells.name: Battle Fervor
spells.description: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to fill you with Battle Fervor. Battle Fervor increases your Haste by 2 for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

244609.name: World Tender's Trunkplate
244609.sourceName: 世界照护者的树干板甲

244610.name: World Tender's Rootslippers
244610.sourceName: 世界照护者的根须便鞋

244611.name: World Tender's Barkclasp
244611.sourceName: 世界照护者的树皮腰扣

spells.name: Murder Row Fishhook
spells.description: Equip: Your harmful spells and abilities have a chance to bleed your target for 846 Physical damage over 10 sec.

spells.name: Hunt
spells.description:
Equip: Your spells and abilities have the chance to grant 168 secondary stats for 15 sec  based on the target creature's type.

This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Hunt.

spells.name: Blood
spells.description:
Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have the chance to grant Farstrider's Guile, increasing your lowest secondary stat by 444 for 15 sec.

When an allied player dies, gain 232 of your highest secondary stat for 15 sec. This effect can only occur once every 5 min.

This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Blood.

spells.name: Rot
spells.description:
Equip: Afflict your target with Rotting Roots dealing 214 Nature Damage every 2 seconds for 6 sec. This effect stacks up to 10 times. New stacks do not refresh applied stacks.

This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Rot.

spells.name: Void
spells.description:
Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have the chance to embolden you in Void Glass granting 123 Versatility over 15 sec. Multiple applications can overlap.

This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Void.

249276.name: Grimoire of the Eternal Light
249276.description: Full of the Light's wisdom, but an inattentive adherent may wander into mouths better left unexplored.

249294.name: Blade of the Blind Verdict
249294.description: "The Light's flame spares no one." - Venel Lightblood

249325.name: Untethered Berserker's Grips
249325.description: The one place she could let go was in battle. At least before.

249340.name: Wraps of Cosmic Madness
249340.description: Is it mad to sacrifice your world for victory?

spells.name: Wraps of Cosmic Madness
spells.description:
Use: Desperately unravel yourself over 2 sec to unleash a barrage of 11 cosmic missiles at your target, increased by your haste. Each deals 225 Cosmic damage split between nearby enemies. Damage increased by 30% per additional enemy, up to 150%.

Allied deaths induce further madness, reducing the cooldown by 60 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

spells.name: Volatile Void Suffuser
spells.description: Equip: Your healing spells and abilities have a high chance to grant you Void Suffusion for 12 sec, increasing your Intellect by 14 plus an additional 0 Intellect for every 1% health the target was missing. Multiple Suffusions may overlap.

249343.name: Gaze of the Alnseer
249343.description: There are some places the faithful dare not look.

spells.name: Gaze of the Alnseer
spells.description: Equip: Your damage and healing has a chance to grant you Alnsight for 12 sec. While active, casting spells and abilities manifests unstable Alnscorned and consumes their essence to grant you 2 Intellect for 12 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

spells.name: Nullsight
spells.description: Use: Seize the eye's draconic power, granting you 148 Mastery diminishing over 15 sec and allowing you to see hidden enemies. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

spells.name: Riftbloom
spells.description: Use: Synthesize a soulbound set chest item appropriate for your class.

spells.name: Hungering Nullcore
spells.description: Use: Synthesize a soulbound set hand item appropriate for your class.

spells.name: Fanatical Nullcore
spells.description: Use: Synthesize a soulbound set head item appropriate for your class.

spells.name: Corrupted Nullcore
spells.description: Use: Synthesize a soulbound set leg item appropriate for your class.

spells.name: Unraveled Nullcore
spells.description: Use: Synthesize a soulbound set shoulder item appropriate for your class.

249367.name: Chiming Void Curio
249367.description: Find Kirana near the entrance to the March on Quel'Danas to trade this for powerful class set armor.

spells.name: Eternal Voidsong Chain
spells.description: Equip: Dealing Shadow damage has a chance to unleash a Voidstalker Sting, dealing 103 Shadow damage to your target over 10 sec. If reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the next Sting.

spells.name: Beacon of Lightblind Wrath
spells.description:
Use: Invoke the litany to apply Beacon of Lightblind Wrath to an enemy for 30 sec. Your next 5 harmful spells call down a blast of Light to deal 289 Holy damage to the target.

5 injured allies are shielded for the same amount, absorbing 50% of damage taken while the shield holds. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

249809.name: Locus-Walker's Ribbon
249809.description: "Do you wish to learn more of the Void? It has many lessons to teach us amongst its maddening whispers." - Locus-Walker

spells.name: Locus-Walker's Ribbon
spells.description:
Equip: Casting spells has a high chance to tempt you with the power of the Void, increasing your Intellect by 19 for 10 sec.

Each temptation permanently increases this effect by 5%, up to 10 times, diminishing quickly upon leaving combat.

spells.name: Shadow of the Empyrean Requiem
spells.description:
Equip: Your harmful spells have a high chance to call cosmic shards from the heavens to slice your target and one nearby enemy for 385 Cosmic damage.

If either enemy is below 35% health, gain 14 Haste for 12 sec as you speed them to their fate.

249811.name: Light of the Cosmic Crescendo
249811.description: There was a time when her song filled hearts with hope.

spells.name: Light of the Cosmic Crescendo
spells.description:
Equip: Your healing has a high chance to inflict Cosmic Crescendo on a nearby enemy, dealing 1 Cosmic damage every 3 sec until their death, stacking up to 25 times.

Hum a cosmic hymn every 2 sec, consuming a Cosmic Crescendo stack if any ally is below 60% health to heal them and up to 4 injured allies for 228 split between them. Healing increased by 30% per additional ally, up to 150%.

spells.name: Eye of Midnight
spells.description: Equip: Taking Shadow damage greater than 15% of your maximum health grants you a barrier absorbing up to 240 damage and increasing your Avoidance by 10 while it holds. This effect may occur every 30 sec.

249922.name: Tome of Alnscorned Regret
249922.description: Are you certain you wish to understand the Alnscorned? To make their pain your own?

249998.name: Enforcer's Grips of the Black Talon
249998.sourceName: 黑爪龙人的执法者护手

spells.name: Emberwing Heatwave
spells.description:
Use: Unleash an Emberwing Heatwave, increasing your Haste by 68 for 15 sec.

You have a low chance to suffer an Emberwing Burn, reducing one of your other secondary stats by 21 for 10 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

250223.name: Soulcatcher's Charm
250223.description: Vordaza's necromantic fetish is covered in inscrutable carvings and has a heavy, ominous aura.

spells.name: Echo of the Evercurse
spells.description:
Equip: Your damaging spells have a chance to haunt the target, dealing 338 Shadow damage over 12 sec.

If the target dies while haunted, the effect transfers to a nearby enemy, inflicting 150% of the Shadow damage over the remaining duration.

spells.name: Refueling Orb
spells.description: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to release an energy orb that bounces between up to 5 nearby allies, increasing their Versatility by 5 for 12 sec. If an ally is below 50% health, the orb heals them for 80 instead.

spells.name: Whisper of the Duskwraith
spells.description:
Equip: Your healing spells and abilities have a chance to release a spirit of the Duskwraith, leaping to your target and healing them for 378.

If the target's health is below 40%, the spirit empowers them further, granting 7 Versatility for 10 sec.

spells.name: Heart of Wind
spells.description: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to awaken the Heart of Wind, surrounding you with strong gales that increase your Haste by 22 for 10 sec.

spells.name: Eye of the Drowning Void
spells.description: Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have a chance to tear open a rift of the Void within your target, erupting for 194 Shadow damage split among nearby enemies.

250258.name: Vessel of Tortured Souls
250258.description: Don't tap the glass. They don't like that.

spells.name: Vessel of Souls
spells.description: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to awaken a soul within the vessel. Each soul you collect increases your Intellect by 3 for 1 min.

spells.name: Voidstone Barrier
spells.description:
On Use: Activate the array and generate a Voidstone Barrier, absorbing 71,596 damage for the next 10 sec.

The barrier is further empowered by 1% per unique gem color you have socketed.

251161.name: Shroud of the Soulhunter
251161.description: A relic of the twisted rituals secret to the Vilebranch.

251178.name: Ceremonial Hexblade
251178.description: A blade used in the foul ceremony to raise and empower Rak'thul.

spells.name: Loa Worshiper's Band
spells.description:
Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have a chance to charge the band, calling forth the avatar of a Loa to assist you in combat.

Each unique socketed gem color in your gear allows for different Loa to be summoned. These effects range from dealing damage to your foes or granting you temporary power.

spells.name: Radiant Blessing
spells.description:
Use: Bathe your target ally in radiant light, healing them for 670 and imbuing them for 20 sec.
While imbued, your healing spells and abilities also heal this ally for 26. (2 Min Cooldown)

spells.description: Equip: Dealing Nature damage has a chance to inflict Rotbloom, dealing 1,718 Nature damage over 15 sec. If the enemy is already afflicted by your Rotbloom, it is consumed to deal 120% of its remaining damage.

spells.name: Rotmire's Sporeheart
spells.description: Equip: Your healing has a chance to spawn protective toadstools absorbing 19,539 damage for up to 12 sec. If broken, the toadstools burst to deal 2,695 Nature damage to nearby enemies.

spells.description: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to nourish the mycelium, granting you 215 of a random secondary stat and Leech for 12 sec.

effects.displayString: Set: Gain 35 Haste while above 80% health.
Set: Gain 35 Critical Strike while above 80% health.
Set: Your spells and abilities can beseech the World Trees for a fragment of their power, granting you 35 of a random secondary stat for 15 sec.
Set: Your harmful spells and abilities have a chance to unleash a Twilight Barrage at your target.
Set: Eruption damage increased by 10% and it extends Ebon Might by an additional 0.1 sec.
Set: While Ebon Might is active, empower spells deal 10% more damage and cool down 10% faster.
